rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a risky or daring undertaking.

example.english: I want to travel to Tibet alone and have an adventure.
example.traditional: 我想一個人去西藏旅行，試下冒險。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 sai1 zong6 leoi5 hang4 si3 haa5 mou6 him2

rows.note: Use this for a person's desire or willingness to seek new and exciting experiences.

example.english: They have a real spirit of adventure and are always talking about visiting places they have never been.
example.traditional: 佢好有冒險精神，成日話要去啲未去過嘅地方。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 mou6 him2 zing1 san4 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 heoi3 di1 mei6 heoi3 gwo3 ge3 dei6 fong1
